title: SightingsRecord
description: Historical plate detection log record schema - persists every observed license plate for trajectory tracking (Commandment 7)

sighting_id.description: Auto-generated UUID primary key for the sighting event

department.description: Camera owning department (e.g. Police, GSRTC, Municipal Corp)

plate_number.description: Normalized license plate registration number, e.g. GJ01AB1234

pts_timestamp_ms.description: Hardware presentation timestamp in milliseconds from cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_MSEC) (Commandment 2)

confidence.description: Plate detection and OCR recognition confidence score

direction_of_travel.description: Estimated direction of vehicle motion from Kalman tracker velocity vector

snapshot_url.description: Storage URL or local path to cropped plate / vehicle image

snapshot_hash_sha256.description: SHA-256 cryptographic hash of image for NFSU evidentiary chain of custody

watchlist_match_flag.description: Flag indicating if this plate matched an active eGujCop/VAHAN watchlist entry

associated_fir.description: Linked police FIR number if plate is associated with an active case, else null
